actions.text: This elevator just announced arrival at Floor Negative Twelve. That is highly irregular.
The wiring in this building is ancient and prone to very strange glitches.

beats.blocking: Voss stands at the elevator doors; Mara stands by the maintenance panel.
beats.intended_reaction: Voss looks up in confusion; Mara sighs heavily.
beats.narrative_purpose: Hook: The elevator dings and lights flicker aggressively.
beats.visible_action: The hallway lights flicker rapidly as the elevator dings.

actions.text: Did you hear that? The elevator is singing in a language I don't know!
Singing is not a recognized feature in the standard building occupancy code.

beats.blocking: Ellis enters from apartment 3b; Voss turns toward him.
beats.intended_reaction: Voss steps back to make room; Mara looks stressed.
beats.narrative_purpose: Ellis enters to escalate the curiosity.
beats.visible_action: Ellis rushes toward the elevator doors with intense curiosity.

actions.text: It is just air pressure escaping the shaft. Please stop bothering the inspector.
Air pressure does not typically recite epic poetry in a minor key, Madam.

beats.blocking: Mara moves toward Ellis to block his view of the elevator.
beats.intended_reaction: Ellis leans around her; Voss takes out a notepad.
beats.narrative_purpose: Mara tries to deflect the investigation.
beats.visible_action: Mara gestures wildly toward the maintenance panel.

actions.text: Look! The interior looks like a nebula made of liquid grape soda!
I am marking this down as an unauthorized atmospheric modification in the hallway.
It is just a very aggressive mood lighting installation for the lobby.

beats.blocking: The elevator doors open to reveal a glowing purple light.
beats.intended_reaction: Voss stares blankly; Ellis gasps loudly.
beats.narrative_purpose: Physical escalation: the elevator doors open.
beats.visible_action: The elevator doors slide open with a heavy thud.

actions.text: This violates section four regarding non-standard dimensions in public transit areas.
We can fix the dimensions by Monday if you just sign this waiver.
Can I go inside? I want to see if it tastes like grapes!

beats.blocking: Voss approaches the elevator; Mara follows him closely.
beats.intended_reaction: Mara winces; Ellis tries to peek closer.
beats.visible_action: Voss points a pen at the glowing elevator interior.

actions.text: My clipboard! The elevator has consumed my official documentation and my dignity!
I told you the maintenance was going to be a real nightmare today.
At least the grape soda smell is actually quite pleasant, don't you think?

beats.blocking: The elevator doors slam shut on Voss's notepad.
beats.intended_reaction: Voss looks at his empty hands; Mara facepalms.
beats.narrative_purpose: Payoff: The elevator pulls them in or slams shut.
beats.visible_action: The elevator doors close violently; the lights flicker one last time.

logline: Voss attempts to document the elevator's illogical behavior while Mara desperately tries to maintain the facade of normalcy.
payoff: The elevator doors slam shut, leaving Voss without his clipboard and Mara contemplating her life choices.
